---
name: Challenge a judgement
about: Say that a classification, grouping or placement on the dashboard is wrong or out of date
title: "Challenge: <judgement id or country> — <one line>"
labels: judgement-challenge
---

**Which call?**
Judgement id if you know it (shown under "How this tab is defined"), otherwise the country and what
you saw.

**What do you think it should be?**

**Why?**
Links to sources help most: an electoral authority, a pollster's own publication, an expert survey.

**Does it matter now?**
For example: an election in the next few weeks, a party that has just split.

---
Challenges are answered at the monthly review. A change, if agreed, arrives as a pull request that the
owner approves. Nothing changes automatically.
